description: This file defines the InlineAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of tasks and their associated activities within an Android application. It manages task highlighting, inflates views for each task, and shows dialogs with activity intent flags.

classes.name: InlineAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that displays a list of Task objects, highlighting the currently running task.

classes.name: InlineAdapter.TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding task data and associated activities to the RecyclerView item view.

methods.name: InlineAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of tasks and the activity context.

methods.name: indexOfRunningTask
methods.description: Finds and returns the index of the task corresponding to the current activity.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for a task item and creates a new TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the ViewHolder, highlighting the running activity if applicable.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tasks.

methods.name: setTask
methods.description: Populates a ViewHolder with task data, including setting up activity views and click listeners.

methods.name: showDialogWithFlags
methods.description: Displays a dialog showing the list of intent flags for a given activity.
